samples.text: Today is a good day to validate text to speech serving behavior. The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog while the server streams audio. Please read this sentence in a steady, clear, and natural voice.
这是一个用于语音合成服务测试的中文句子。我们希望在整段文字还没有全部生成完成的时候，就能听到前面的声音。两个请求同时到达时，也应该分别连续输出自己的音频，并且完整地读完最后一句话。

sampling_note: HTTP seed is forwarded; Talker temperature/top_p/top_k use model defaults unless separately configured by server.
